summary.en: The threaded pile is swallowed in one pull: every item slides back along the thread into the mascot, the nearest first, shrinking to a speck, while the thread reels in behind the farthest; all arrive together.
summary.zh: 串好的一堆被一口拉走：每件沿线滑回吉祥物，近的先走，缩成一点，线跟在最远那件后面收回；全部同时到达。

fits: Ending a pile: the product takes everything in one move.
notFor: Items that must stay readable; a merge into a hub with several sources (hub-links).

intent.en: Make taking everything over feel like one effortless pull.
intent.zh: 让“全部接手”像轻松的一拉。

content.en: Nothing to read: the threaded items and the point they go into.
content.zh: 没有字：串着的东西和它们被收进去的那个点。

fits.zh: 收掉一堆东西：产品一下子全拿走。

notFor.zh: 要保持可读的东西；多个来源汇进一个中心（用 hub-links）。

pairs.note: before: the thread runs through the pile

en: All items must arrive on the same frame: the lateness is a share of the distance, not a fixed stagger.
Fade only the last quarter; earlier fading makes it read as disappearing, not as being taken.
zh: 所有东西要在同一帧到达：延迟按距离占比算，不是固定错开。
只在最后四分之一淡出；淡得早就像消失，而不是被拿走。

source.path: assets/templates/stream/film.js renderOpen (the tug: 0.6 beat × distance share late, io2 over 2.5 beats, scale 1 → 0.08)

overlaps.note: its merge mode slides several sources into one hub; reel-in pulls a whole pile along one thread into a point

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
